name: Chattering Jaws

items.name: Incessant Chattering
items.text: Jaws always chatter at a predetermined time, such as during specific times of day or in response to a trigger, such as noticing a creature within 30 feet. During these times, the chattering jaws can be automatically heard by all creatures within 60 feet.

items.name: Gnashing Rage
items.text: When chattering jaws are destroyed, all other animated bones within 30 feet that can see or hear the chattering jaws become Quickened 1 for 1 minute. The animated bones can use this extra action to Stride or Strike.

text:
Chattering jaws usually serve no purpose other unnerving people by clicking their teeth together. Some chattering jaws only chatter at regular intervals to help tell the time.
